findings.description: In `MacrophageCell._patrol_observe`, the timing spike detection uses `median_t > 0.1` as a gate for flagging spikes. Because 0.1 is not exactly representable in binary floating-point, the comparison is unreliable: a median computed from values that mathematically equal 0.1 may compare strictly greater or less depending on floating‑point error, causing inconsistent detection. This is a correctness defect — the code intends to skip spike detection when absolute timings are negligible, but the threshold is fragile.
